decisions.reason: The area elastic sports floor system extends an established sports flooring line with in-house production and its own product page, so dropping it would write off real investment, and weak results during the pandemic years can be blamed on temporary closures of sports facilities.

The mobile arena floor system required substantial development and production investment and was publicly presented, and its weak demand can be attributed to the temporary halt of events, which favors persisting with it.
This second mobile arena system overlaps with B, which makes it somewhat more expendable, but the sunk investment and public presentation still favor keeping it while event markets recover.

The chevron parquet is shown on the home page, is close to the core offer and fits the announced trend-led, natural-aesthetic direction, so dropping it would contradict the firm's visible commitments.

The squash court finish is a niche product that needed little investment, which makes dropping it cheap, but it is a low-cost add-on to the sports line and its weak sales can still be attributed to the temporary pandemic downturn.
The oak skirting is a cheap accessory that complements the sports floor systems the firm is committed to, so it would likely stay as part of the package even though little has been invested in it.
